title: "The combination of weak passwords and weak hashing algorithms significantly ...

name: TextBox 6
text: "The combination of weak passwords and weak hashing algorithms significantly increases the risk of password recovery after a data breach. Modern AI-based password guessing tools such as PassGAN can exploit predictable password patterns, making strong hashing mechanisms essential for user security.

name: TextBox 9
text: AI has not broken cryptography itself. Instead, it has become highly effective at exploiting human-created password patterns. Organizations must use strong password hashing algorithms (bcrypt, Argon2, PBKDF2) and enforce strong password policies to protect users
